violation_type.title: AP Infants Sleep on Backs or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant (26 TAC §747.2327)
violation_type.short_title: AP Infants Sleep on Backs or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant
violation_type.typical_finding: This rule was investigated with regard to an investigation and the operation was found to be deficient.  Based on the information gathered, it was determined that an infant was placed to sleep on a bed in a bedroom and not in a crib.

finding_variants.text: This rule was investigated with regard to an investigation and the operation was found to be deficient.  Based on the information gathered, it was determined that an infant was placed to sleep on a bed in a bedroom and not in a crib.
A two-month-old infant was asleep on their stomach.    Note- This was corrected during the inspection when the infant was moved to their back to sleep.

An infant, who is 3 months old and unable to roll over, was seen being placed down for a nap on their stomach. The primary caregiver indicated she puts the child in this position because the child's mother insisted that the infant should only sleep on their stomach. This was corrected during the inspection when safe sleep protocols were reviewed and the infant was placed on their back.
During the inspection, a four month old infant was  observed sleeping face down.    Note: it was corrected at the inspection time.
